Affiliate Disclosure

Effective Date: November 17, 2026

At TopBlogTech.com (“TopBlogTech”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), we believe that radical transparency and editorial integrity are the bedrock of any trusted technology publication. In compliance with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines concerning the use of endorsements and testimonials in advertising (16 CFR Part 255), we provide this clear, comprehensive disclosure detailing how our website operates, how we utilize affiliate links, and how our commercial relationships interact with our editorial evaluation process.

1. Commitment to FTC Compliance & Transparency

The Federal Trade Commission mandates that digital publications, creators, and online reviewers explicitly disclose when an endorsement, review, or recommendation involves a financial relationship. Under FTC guidelines, readers must be informed if clicking a link or purchasing a product through a website can result in monetary compensation for the publisher.

TopBlogTech.com strictly adheres to these standards. Readers should assume that every outbound link directing to a commercial product, software subscription, digital tool, cloud platform, or physical device on TopBlogTech.com may be an affiliate link. When you click one of these links and complete a purchase or sign up for a service, TopBlogTech.com may receive monetary compensation, referral fees, or an affiliate commission from the respective vendor.

2. How Affiliate Links Work (Zero Additional Cost to You)

Affiliate marketing is a standard digital publishing business model that enables independent websites to generate revenue without charging visitors for subscriptions, locking articles behind paywalls, or cluttering pages with intrusive pop-up advertisements. Here is an exact breakdown of the referral process:

  1. Tracking Attribution: When you click a tracked affiliate link on TopBlogTech.com, your web browser is redirected through an affiliate tracking network (such as Impact, ShareASale, CJ Affiliate, or a direct merchant dashboard) which places a standard tracking cookie or referral identifier in your browser.
  2. Attribution Window: This cookie signals to the merchant that your visit originated from TopBlogTech.com. These tracking cookies remain active for a predetermined cookie lifespan (typically between 24 hours and 90 days, depending on merchant terms).
  3. Vendor Commission: If you complete a qualifying purchase or subscription during that attribution window, the merchant pays TopBlogTech.com a referral commission from their existing marketing budget.
  4. Zero Cost Penalty: Purchasing through an affiliate link never costs you an extra cent. The pricing you pay is identical to—or in many cases lower than—navigating directly to the vendor’s public storefront.
  5. Exclusive Reader Discounts: Because of our established publishing relationships, merchants frequently provide TopBlogTech with custom promo codes, discounted introductory rates, extended free trials, or waived onboarding fees that directly benefit our audience.

User Privacy & Data Security: Affiliate tracking mechanisms record only the referral origin, timestamp, and transaction ID. TopBlogTech never receives, stores, or accesses your payment information, credit card details, physical address, or personally identifiable financial data. All transactions are securely processed directly on the merchant’s encrypted checkout platform.

3. Affiliate Programs We Participate In

TopBlogTech.com partners with established affiliate networks and direct merchant programs across the technology, web development, cloud computing, and digital productivity ecosystems. Our active affiliate relationships include, but are not limited to:

  • Amazon Services LLC Associates Program: TopBlogTech.com is a participant in the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.com and affiliated international marketplaces. As an Amazon Associate, TopBlogTech earns from qualifying purchases.
  • Web Hosting & Cloud Infrastructure Programs: We participate in affiliate partner programs with prominent cloud hosting, virtual private server (VPS), and managed WordPress hosting providers, including Hostinger, Cloudways, SiteGround, DigitalOcean, and Bluehost.
  • Virtual Private Network (VPN) & Cybersecurity Programs: We partner with industry-leading cybersecurity, data encryption, and privacy providers, including NordVPN, Surfshark, ExpressVPN, and major password management platforms.
  • Software & SaaS Affiliate Programs: We maintain affiliate partnerships with digital publishing software vendors, AI developer platforms, workflow automation engines (such as Make.com), SEO auditing platforms, and productivity SaaS suites.

4. Specific Examples of Affiliate Relationships

To help you understand exactly how our affiliate partnerships manifest in our content, here are concrete real-world examples across our primary coverage categories:

  • Web Hosting Comparisons & Tutorials: In our architectural blueprints and web hosting guides, we frequently compare cloud hosts and managed server platforms. When we include an affiliate link to a provider such as Cloudways or Hostinger, and you subsequently register for a hosting account or provision a cloud server, TopBlogTech receives a referral fee from that hosting company.
  • VPN & Network Security Reviews: When evaluating VPN services, we run quantitative WireGuard throughput benchmarks, DNS leak audits, and privacy evaluations. Our review articles contain tracked affiliate buttons to services like NordVPN or Surfshark. If you purchase an annual VPN subscription through those links, our publication receives an affiliate commission.
  • AI Productivity & Developer Tools: In our coverage of generative AI platforms, developer coding assistants, and workflow automation suites, we test specialized SaaS applications (such as Make.com or AI writing utilities). If you upgrade to a paid subscription or purchase API credits through our tracked recommendation links, the software vendor shares a percentage of that transaction with us.
  • Hardware & Developer Peripherals (Amazon Associates): In hardware buying guides or workstation setup recommendations, product links pointing to mechanical keyboards, ergonomic monitors, or home lab networking hardware route to Amazon.com. When you complete an Amazon order after clicking our links, we earn a modest referral percentage at no added expense to you.

5. Editorial Independence & Objective Testing Standards

We maintain an uncompromising firewall between our commercial partnerships and our editorial team. Affiliate partnerships and financial compensation never dictate our editorial coverage, benchmark results, product rankings, or review conclusions.

Our editorial desk operates under strict professional standards:

  • No Paid Positive Coverage: We do not accept monetary payments, sponsorship fees, or complimentary merchandise in exchange for positive reviews or favorable rankings. Commercial entities cannot purchase favorable placement on our site.
  • Objective, Hands-On Benchmarks: Our software and infrastructure reviews are built on documented technical metrics—including server response times, cryptographic standards, API documentation quality, and real-world reliability—rather than marketing claims.
  • Unvarnished Criticism: If an affiliate partner’s software exhibits security vulnerabilities, steep price increases, deceptive auto-renewals, or degraded performance, we state those shortcomings unequivocally. We will not hesitate to advise readers against purchasing a sub-par product, even if doing so results in forfeited commissions.
  • Recommending Non-Affiliate Solutions: We regularly endorse free, open-source software (FOSS), community-driven repositories, and non-monetized utilities whenever they represent the best technical choice for our audience.
  • Alignment with Editorial Standards: Our testing methodology, fact-checking criteria, and guidelines on responsible generative AI usage are documented in detail in our published Editorial Policy. We encourage all visitors to review our editorial standards.

6. How to Identify Affiliate Links on Our Website

To ensure complete clarity while reading our content, TopBlogTech implements multiple visual and technical indicators to identify affiliate material:

  • Top-of-Page Disclosures: Every article, guide, and comparison containing affiliate links features a prominent editorial disclosure notice positioned immediately beneath the article title or above the primary content body.
  • Link Attributes: Outbound commercial links utilize standardized rel="sponsored nofollow" attributes in compliance with Google Search Essentials and FTC endorsement standards.
  • Contextual Notices: Within comparative tables and product showcase boxes, call-to-action buttons (e.g., “View Pricing”, “Check Current Deal”, or “Visit Website”) clearly signify commercial outbound pathways.

7. Contact Our Editorial Desk

We welcome reader oversight and strive to maintain the highest level of accountability across all published research. If you have any questions regarding this Affiliate Disclosure, our commercial relationships, or how we evaluate products, please reach out directly to our editorial team:

  • Email: contact@topblogtech.com
  • Editorial Policy: https://topblogtech.com/editorial-policy/
  • Mailing Address: TopBlogTech.com Editorial Desk, 1309 Coffeen Avenue STE 1200, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States

TopBlogTech Editorial Team

Technology & Digital Publishing Research Desk

The TopBlogTech Editorial Team consists of experienced web developers, technical SEO analysts, and digital creators dedicated to delivering actionable, evidence-based blueprints on modern blogging, website architecture, and ethical online monetization.

Last updated: November 18, 2026

This page explains how TopBlogTech.com (“TopBlogTech”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) handles affiliate links and other commercial relationships. It follows the principle in the U.S. Federal Trade Commission’s Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255) that readers should be told when a publisher may be paid because of a recommendation.

1. Current Status: No Affiliate Links

TopBlogTech.com currently contains no affiliate links. We do not currently receive commissions, referral fees, sponsorship payments or free products from any company mentioned on the site, and we do not display advertising. The external links in our articles point to official documentation, help centres and other reference sources, and we earn nothing when you click them.

2. If We Add Affiliate Links in the Future

The site may use affiliate links in the future. An affiliate link is a tracked link: if you click it and then buy or sign up, the merchant may pay us a commission. If we start using them, we will:

  • Mark them clearly: place a short disclosure notice near the top of any article that contains affiliate links, before the first such link.
  • Label them technically: add the rel="sponsored" attribute to affiliate links, which Google asks publishers to use for paid links.
  • Update this page: list the affiliate programs we participate in.

When you click an affiliate link, the merchant or affiliate network may place a cookie in your browser to attribute the referral. We would not receive your payment details. See our Privacy Policy for more on cookies.

3. Editorial Independence

  • No paid coverage: We do not accept payment, sponsorship or free products in exchange for coverage or favourable rankings.
  • Research-based, not hands-on testing: Our guides are researched from official documentation, published pricing pages, release notes and independent published sources. We do not run our own hands-on benchmarks or lab tests; when a guide mentions performance figures, it cites where they come from.
  • Drawbacks stated: We describe limitations, price increases and risks where our sources show them, whether or not a product would earn us anything in the future.
  • Free options included: We mention free and open-source alternatives when they are a good fit.
  • Editorial standards: Our research and correction practices are described in our Editorial Policy.

4. Advertising

TopBlogTech.com does not currently display ads. If the site is approved for Google AdSense in the future, ads will be visually separate from article content, advertisers will have no say over what we publish, and our Privacy Policy will be updated first.

5. Contact

If you have questions about this disclosure, email contact@topblogtech.com.
